actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent hypoxia/glycolysis/proliferation transcriptional program with positive cross-modal structural support and no technical confounder explaining membership; retained for downstream validation despite weak WXS/CNV corroboration.
C0002 shows a coherent immune-inflamed RNA program with striking BAP1 enrichment, consistent cross-modal structural support, and no technical confounder; retained for downstream validation.

C0003 has coherent multi-modal biological support (WNT/TGF-beta up, proliferation down, PBRM1-mutant/BAP1-wildtype, loss-depleted), positive cross-modal structure, and no technical confounder; retained for downstream validation.

C0004 shows a coherent VHL/PBRM1-wildtype profile with distinct copy-number alterations, high structural resampling stability, and no technical confounder; retained for downstream validation despite non-significant RNA.

C0005 has a coherent metabolic/lipid transcriptional phenotype with corroborating mutation and copy-number signals, positive cross-modal structure, and no technical confounder; retained for downstream validation.

C0006 lacks significant biological support in any modality, with only weak non-significant trends and cross-modal structure driven almost entirely by a single WXS probe; no credible structural revision resolves this, so it is not defensible as a discovery-stage candidate.
C0007 (n=2) provides no estimable biological evidence, internal structure is non-estimable, and cross-modal support is mixed; no defensible subtype identity can be established.
